effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
＜Fragment (2)＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by trashing any 2 of its digivolution cards, it isn't deleted.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜De-Digivolve 3＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 3 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, by placing 2 level 5 or lower [Machine], [Cyborg] or [ME] trait cards from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, your opponent's effects can't trash any of your Digimon's stacked cards until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
